course_name: 網路專題與問題導向學習
outline:
The course is aimed to discuss theoretical frameworks of problem based learning and project based learning and its application in medical education and social studies. In addition , the course is discussed in application in web based problem based learning and project based learning ,and the limits of the design.
探討網路專題與問題導向學習之相關原理，以及實務應用。內容包括有網路學習專題與問題導向之理論基礎、優點、特性、限制、科技、媒體、設計與發展、環境、教師教學、學生學習、評量、實際案例、未來趨勢。
